input.variables: Identical ordered algebraically independent variables in both matrices and every entry; at most eight.
input.dimensions: Nonempty rectangular matrices with compatible inner dimensions; at most eight rows and columns.
input.polynomials: At most 4096 nonzero terms, strictly descending lexicographic exponent tuples.
input.coefficients: Reduced decimal-string num/den, positive denominator; zero represented by no terms.
input.rational_functions: Coprime numerator and denominator with monic denominator.

output: A SymbolicMatrix containing the canonical exact row-by-column product.
scope: One universal two-by-two matrix times its adjugate. This does not certify the arbitrary-rank determinacy or algebraization theorem.
